description: Existing interface acceptance gates for reviewed but UNAPPROVED Toolkit <-> XIHeadless cross-project execution. These are expected behaviors, not observed gameplay or candidate protocol messages.

vectors.fact: Toolkit can re-evaluate synthetic MOG-09 values to PASS, but does not independently authenticate an XIHeadless supervised run or source byte provenance.
Absent local operator, character allowlist and supervisor configuration fail the current MOG-09 preflight, even for its verified runner.
An absent client/server Mog Safe readback leaves canonical assertions blocked despite runner-reported PASS.
A task cancellation or acknowledgment is not a terminal canonical assertion verdict or Toolkit importer report.
Partially reported MOG-09 observations cannot satisfy all existing assertions.
Toolkit v1 report does not model distinct operation/attempt IDs; duplicate run_id/case_id/stage within a report is rejected.
No generic verified runner may be assigned to INV-OBS-01 or the 73 design-only staged cases; no GM mutation permission is implied.
Canonical optional-v2 metadata compatibility blocks a declared source revision mismatch against separately supplied revisions.
Importer v1 uses insert-only SQLite keys and does not provide idempotent replay or attempt-aware conflict reconciliation; #1202 owns it.
McpResult Accepted has accepted=true with completed omitted; status is not a gameplay PASS or importable Toolkit report.
